fields.description: The one branch this certificate/key pair is scoped to. Only ever used to sign QZ Tray requests made in this branch's context - not shared with other branches.
fields.label: Branch

fields.description: Free-text note to help identify whose key this is at a glance (e.g. "Karachi - Till 1 PC") since the record name is just the branch.
